**v4.1.3 - Aquamirae Update and fixes**

This update largely updates mods as it was a bit neglected. Aquamirae finally gets an update so you can experience it like you see in those Tiktok edits
REMINDER ONCE MORE!!
We have decided that we are removing both Bumblezone and Deeper and Darker! This removal will happen in about 2-3 Updates! More info on when exactly and what to do will follow the coming weeks.
This is part of our debloating of Prominence as both dimensions don't serve a direct purpose. Honey items will be added to Vaaz trades in the same update as these mods are being removed.
This means any block from both of these mods, including their Dimension will be gone, once the mod is removed. Sorry to all the Bee fans and the singular Deep Dark fan, if you still exist!

We are currently aware of an issue causing mob spawn to be weird and are working on a fix. There is a temp fix in the Discord if you want to try it. It will most likely be fixed by next update.

- Added more Quest info to the dimension and such

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.1.1 - The great Rebalance Part 1**

This Update Fixes a couple of issues that have come with the latest Simply Swords update. Many weapons that have been a bit too strong are also nerfed while we are at it. Classic game devs smh... 
Items like Gh'aj were way too weak and as we all know, nerf Archer. So that is exactly what we did. Many more weapons have been made more viable, to encourage build variety. Just because your current build isnt mentioned here, doesn't mean it will never be adjusted or buffed/nerfed. There is many more planned changes. Changes are loosely grouped for each class.

We are also aware the the Wither currently does not drop Simplyswords and are working on a fix.
## Changes

### Fixes
- Temporarily using the Essential zoom(not as cool we know) until Zoomify is fixed
- Fixed OPAC UI related crash
- Simply Swords such as Sunfire can now use their Abilities again - you may need to rebind the ability button if you are still experiencing issues
- Simply Swords such as Harbinger and Lichblade now show their proper cool textures again
- Fixed Simply Bows working in claims even though they shouldn't
- Fixed Crash with Simply Skills
- Fixed an issue with Runes from Simply Swords
- Armor Stands are no longer breakable in Vaaz
- Wrenches no longer work in Vaaz
- Chorus fruit can no longer be consumed in Vaaz
- Fixed a death loop due to dying from max corruption in present and past Vaaz
  
### Additions
- Added Advanced Netherite crafting varians to blast furnace and Alloy Forge
- Added better recipes for MI barrels
- Made Advanced Netherite salvageable
- Added some more ore blocks to the Alloy Forge
- New Soulbound system:
  This replaces the old "edit an offline player's dat file if offline" approach
  Triggers if any soulbound item gets either stolen from you or you dont have enough space in inventory when receiving it

### Balance Changes
- Lowered Watcher Spell Scaling from 1.25 to 0.7
- Lowered Watcher Damage Scaling from 0.85 to 0.6
- The Watcher no longer executes everything under 25% hp, as a matter of fact it will never execute again
- Removed additional Holy Spell power from Watcher as it was not supposed to have it anymore, lol
- Made Bloodwake scale with Blood, did the same for a few other weapons such as Caelestis now scaling with Arcane
- Keep in mind that most Summons scale with healing and Soul
- Lowered Enigma Fling Upward Strength from 0.55 to 0.3, this will make mobs fly less high
- Lowered both Battle Standards to what they were supposed to have
- Lowered Winterfangs Shots count, arrow speed, homing radius, base damage, homing acceleration, bounty rune damage multiplier and extra arrow multiplier
- Simply Bows now can only have 3 Upgrades and only 2 of each
- Lowered Sindorei Heritage Draw speed bonus from +100% to +50%
- Lowered Strike Spell Scaling of Soulstalker
- Gh'aj now gives Haste and Artifact damage per node, alternating between higher artifact dmg and higher haste, middle node now gives additional 10% haste
- Supernova now gives +5% Spell haste instead of 12% Haste as it was used only for the haste by rogues
- Lowered Shadowsting Damage modifier from 1.0 to 0.66
- Lowered Shadowsting attack speed by 0.3
- Lowered Shadowsting onhit chance from 40 to 20
- Lowered Spell scaling from 2.5 to 1.75
- Increase Cooldown of the Ability from 200 to 225
- Lowered duration from 100 to 75
- Emberlash now can have twice the stacks
- Lightning weapons like Ionbound Stormscale and Mjolnir are now more viable for Valkyries and no longer scale with Physical
- Thunderbrand now scales better for both Valkyrie and Warrior
- Stormlash Rune now better scales with lightning, perfect for lightning builds
- Runic Slash Rune has been lowered to scale far less with Physical Damage and Arcane
- Dancing Blades Rune now goes up to 20, but the individual blades deal less damage
- Evocation Rune is now Unholy and scales better with it, great for mob farms

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.0.5 - Defensive Enchants Rebalance and Advancements fix**

This update fixes Advancements in multiplayer only being given to some players and not all of them. Players will be able to stack multiple defensive enchants(Battle Rouse, Warding, Spellbreaking and so forth) on top of their Protection. - Reason as to this change is so that it appears more often in mid-late game Enchanting Table setups
- Lowered Rarities of a few less significant Enchants to replace Protection's spot like Spellbreaking and Suppression

- Added a mod to fix GLFW sometimes not working for some users
- Fixed Advancements not being given to all players that killed the boss
- Fixed NPCs in Vaaz not wanting to talk to you because of missing Advancements
- Fixed a crash for some players with the Advancement Tab
- Fixed a few formatting issues in the Minecells Tab
- Fixed Mutant Skeleton Armor buffs being accidentally enabled
- Hammers should no longer break inside claims the player doesn't own

- Updated Mods: Opac Fixes, Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.0.1 - The Kingdom of Vaaz**

An overall hefty patch fixing lots of bugs found on v4.0.0, along with QoL changes.

## Important changes
- Fixed various NPCs not having trades in Vaaz.
- Mythic bosses have been **extremely nerfed** to make them easier for non-minmaxed players.
- Simply Swords now uses Spell Engine spells, making them now work with spellbooks.
- Fixed "tripped and fell" death on mythic challenges
- Fixed progression issues in the campaign, mainly happening on multiplayer
- Added tooltips to many items that are usually not understood by players
- Your keybinds will be reset!

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed custom quest progress being wiped when dying, which could brick the tutorial and other custom quests 
- Fixed the wait for Mirgaff during "The Secret Ingredient" restarting if you left to the Overworld or relogged, the timer now keeps counting wherever you are
- Players that got locked out of the tutorial by the above bug can now run it again
- Fixed the Gu'mas encounter losing track of the arena and boss if you died to him
- Fixed the Flameborn's Stone forgetting your return position if you died in Vaaz, dumping you at world spawn instead
- Fixed Mythic Challenges being accessible by non hasturian era players
- Fixed fake level up messages spamming when killing mobs while at a campaign level limit, you now get a message explaining why you aren't gaining XP instead
- Fixed being unable to walk backwards while attacking even with Feet Control
- Fixed the Flameborn's Call spell icon showing an outdated version of the stone instead of its current look
- Fixed dupe using carryon
- Fixed bard fate giving the old bard passive still
- Fixed the corruption tooltip in inventory saying the eyes spawn in combat, after 999 years

## Quest Changes
- "A Worrying Reunion" and "S'kellak's Reward" now trigger when using the Flameborn's Stone from any dimension, not just the Overworld
- The return objective of "A Worrying Reunion" now completes wherever you came back from instead of hanging if you didn't come from the Overworld
- Fixed boss quests using advancements instead of kill tasks which made quests not complete for party members

## Performance Changes
- Heavily optimized server ticking by patching some mods

## Other Changes
- Forge Guard recipe in the primordial forge now requires a Blazing Magister armor piece instead of Gleaming Magister.
- Talent XP from Warden now gives heavily reduced XP so it can't be farmed for easy levels
- Players teleporting into a Vaaz era they shouldn't be in yet are now sent back to the era they belong in
- Derelict's spiders and the cultists now only spawn around players during Hasturian Era
- New community translation packs now enable themselves automatically if you already have that language's translation folder enabled in the resource packs menu
- The XP bar in the Talent Tree menu got a fresh look, level displayed is now the player level, the bar now shows your actual level progress, and the tooltip now tells you your talent points and when the next one is obtained. While at a campaign level limit the indicator turns red so it's clear why you aren't leveling (plus a message sent in the chat to remiind players)
- Artifact tree screens got a matching cleanup: headers now say "Artifact Upgrades" and "Artifact Upgrade Points left", and the bar tooltip shows your Artifact Level (out of 7) and the Artifact Power needed for the next upgrade. The points counter on talent and artifact screens is now yellow and the menu titles pop more with an outline
- The developer badge now shows before the name instead of after it in chat
- Simply Swords unique weapon abilities are now real spells! Right click triggers them exactly like before (hold abilities charge like spells now), they show up in the spell hotbar with the weapon as the spell icon and a proper cooldown display, and your spellbook spells stay usable on the number keys while holding these weapons
- Disabled Levitation Shot & Spell Infinity,
- Lowered emberstorm's max haste from 11 to 5,
- Blacklisted both gu'mas and the alloy forge controllers from carry on
- Added special gift to those that had an illegal transmog ;)

## Mods
- Updated Prominent, Bard (RPG Series Plus), Alm's Recipe Additions, Spell enchants for armor, Smart Tooltip Scroll, Essential, Create: Tesosterone, Cable Fixes for Prom, FTB X Emi Compat, Euphoria Patches

v3.9.20 Guns and Demons

A **new subclass** just dropped! Guns are now an early to mid game alternative to Bows and crossbows. These Guns scale with ranged damage, but need a ton of ammo! Here is the first four horsemen!

## Prominence II RPG: Hasturian Era
**3.1.0hf - The Great Artifact & Enchanting Update**

![Update Banner](https://github.com/nvb-uy/cdn/blob/main/update-images/prominence-2-rpg/3.1.0.png?raw=true)

This update is the biggest update since v3.0, featuring two new artifacts: Orion (for Archers) and Vaazkar (for Tanks). It also introduces many fixes and new features, such as new questlines (Botania, Spell Tutorial), 3 New Archer Spellbooks, Tiered Spellbooks, Enchanting Limits, new Armor Sets, new Improved Shield Mechanics, leveled bosses now interacting with the player's level, and much more, I invite you to read the whole changelog! 

Initially this version was going to be 3.0.50, but due to the high amount of impactful changes it has been renamed to v3.1.0.
You can expect the Cinderstone Depths Update to release on v3.2 instead!

**TOMS STORAGE HAS BEEN REMOVED.** You will NOT lose your items, but the existing storage network blocks will disappear. Please follow the AE2 questline to make a storage network.

# Important Changes
- **Orion, Hunter of the Stars.** The new, long awaited artifact for Rangers, featuring three unique paths with different gameplay styles.
- **Vaazkar, Protector of the Molten City.** A new shield artifact for tanks, focused towards crowd control and team utility.
- **3 New Archer Spellbooks:** Mintaka's Fright, Alnilam's Sight, Alnitak's Might. They are also the first three Tier III spellbooks, which have a recipe instead of being obtainable in the spell binding table.
- **Enchantment Limits.** Items now can only have up to 6 enchantments. With the exception of unique-tier items having a limit of 8, and artifacts having a limit of 10. In the future you will be able to increase this limit with an item!
- **Tiered Spellbooks.** With the introduction of the new archer spellbooks, various more advanced spellbooks have been promoted to Tiered spellbooks. These books need to be crafted as they cannot be obtained through the Spell Binding Table. There's a questline explaining this!
- **New Armor Sets.** Netherite upgrade sets for Wizards, Archers, Warriors, Rogues, Priests, Paladins and Death Knight armor sets!
- **Decaying Death Knights & Blood Mini-Rework.** Decaying enchantment now works as intended, and Blood Death Knights had a mini-rework with Blood Plague now healing the player based on their blood power.
- **Leveled Campaign Bosses.** Campaign bosses' level requirement now interacts with your actual level; if you're lower level you will deal less damage depending on how much the level difference is. Some bosses, like The Faceless, have a strict requirement and will require you to be their level to deal any significant damage. This requirement is marked in each of their quests at the top.

# Hotfix Changes
- Fixed a crash with Orion in servers
- Fixed Tome of Eternal Winter being uncraftable
- Fixed certain enchants not being applied on base death knight weapons and tier 3 gear 
- Temporarily removed Shield Overhaul and Zigy's Player Animator API due to issues in proxies

# Artifact Changes
- Added Orion, Hunter of the Stars
- Added Vaazkar, Protector of the Molten City
- Added an Upgrade Tree for the hidden Granny's Pan Artifact

## Boss Changes
- Campaign Bosses are now leveled: When there's a recommended level, players will be able to fight it at lower levels but will deal less damage, but with bosses that require a specific level, they won't deal enough damage unless they're the same level as the boss.
- Reduced Decaying King's health from 600 to 400, and its damage by -60%

## Quest Changes
- Added "Unlocking Abilities" tutorial chapter, explaining how to obtain all spellbooks
- Added Botania questline
- Overhauled The End questline, explaining how to get each eye (Held on this for way too long)
- Replaced Ivory Arrow rewards with 
- Fixed Tier IV spellblade having frostmourne as requirement
- Fixed many rewards from the Gear tutorial questline
- Fixed default position of the MI

## Spellbook Changes
- Runic Invocations is now named Astral Invocations
- Astral Invocations now has 39 total spells from 19. Yup.
- See "Recipe Changes" to see tier changes within existing spellbooks.
- Added new texture for all three techniques spellbooks
- Added new texture for the Astral Invocations spellbook

## Talent Changes
- Increased Unholy and Blood powers of Decaying Devotion from 5 to 10

## Recipe Changes
- Dark Armor now requires Netherite Berseker Armor instead of Berserker Armor
- Souldancer now requires Netherite Assassin Armor instead of Assassin Armor
- Death Knights spellbooks are now Tier II and requires a basic crafting recipe using their respective runes and a warrior book.
- Paladin Libram is now Tier II and requires a basic crafting recipe using warrior and priest books.
- Techniques books are now Tier II and requires a basic crafting recipe
- Magister Books (Echoes, Phoenix, Deathchill) are now Tier III and require a crafting recipe that consumes a Cinderstone Trophy.
- Astral Invocations is now Tier III and requires a crafting recipes that consumes a Cinderstone Trophy.
- Fixed Sapphire Armor being uncraftable

## Item Changes
- Reduced efficiency of building wands, maximum range (netherite) is now 64 instead of 256
- Removed Ivory Arrow (Not needed anymore, use tipped arrows wisely instead!)
- Removed Thesis Books
- Removed Tabula Rasa

## Other Changes
- Fabric Loader is now 0.16.10
- Reduced Trick's damage globally by 1.13%
- Building Wands no longer drop blocks when breaking
- Fixed dupe glitch with Traveler's Backpack
- Fixed infusions' attributes only applying once, making things like etyr only give +10 resistance with all 4 pieces instead of +40.
- Fixed corruption infusions being infinitely stackable.

- Added Crash Assistant
- Added Eternal Attributes
- Added Sortilege
- Added Zigy's Player Animator API
- Added More RPG Library
- Added Archers Expansion
- Added Chunk Save Fix

## Prominence II RPG: Hasturian Era

![Update Banner](https://github.com/nvb-uy/cdn/blob/main/update-images/prominence-2-rpg/3.0.20.png?raw=true)

This update changes the progression of player leveling to make it easier for players to progress through the campaign. As players who didn't focus on doing the campaign right away would reach high levels and then face the early bosses with high scaling, making them way more difficult than they should be.

*If you were level 11 or higher and didn't defeat the Night Lich, then your level will be set back to 10! Same applies to players who didn't finish Void's Invasion and were a higher level than 50.*

- **Stage Leveling**. Leveling is now locked behind the content being made. By default players now can level up to level 10, and will unlock 11-50 leveling after defeating the first boss of Void's Invasion. 51-65 leveling is now unlocked once starting Hasturian Era.
- **Dual choices for first boss**. Now the Night Lich is one of the options as the first boss of Void's Invasion, with the other now being the Decaying King. This means that to progress through campaign you can either kill the Night Lich in the Overworld, or Decaying King in the Nether. The Decaying King was buffed to be immune to ranged options, making it a boss option focused towards melee, making it the opposite of Night Lich.
- **Level Indicators**. Bosses will now have level indicators, displaying what level they are.

- Fixed leveling stuck to max 10 even after killing night lich

- Fixed Decaying Devotion's damage increase not working properly

- Thunderwrath now requires an Essence of Glory instead of a Demonic Essence to craft

- Fixed damage increase per stack from A'zhar
- Fixed Fyr'alath not being able to use spell enchants
- Fixed Ekavar counting as a sword instead of staff, making reforge stats incorrect

## Other Changes
- Added Hardening Catalyst rewards for both the Night Lich and Decaying King.
- Added the Decaying King as a level 10 boss.
- Added level plaques to all bosses within the Void's Invasion and Hasturian Era questlines.
- Night Lich is now optional, you can either fight the Night Lich or Decaying King for the first boss progression.

**3.0.10 - Health Overhaul & Blood Death Knights**

This update brings two new big things: A new tank class; the Blood Death Knight. And most importantly, a health overhaul.

From now on, players will start gaining max HP based when they level up. Enemy damage was adjusted and the max hp given by gear and talents was too; the S'kellak's Blessing fate now grants +100 Max HP.

For more info about this, read the [blog post that explains these changes](https://rpg.prominence.wiki/blog/3.0.10-changes)

- **Health Overhaul**: Players will now gain health each level. Talents and armor sets have been adjusted to better suit tank builds, and damage was re-adjusted.

- **New Frostmourne Model**: A new model for the Frostmourne artifact has been forged.
- **Healing!**. Due to the new health adjustments, healers are in a better state and even needed for multiplayer. For singleplayer, there were consumable buffs, like the Health Flask now healing 10% max health + 35% of maximum health over 10s!
- **Healthbars**. The hearts in the HUD have been completely replaced with a healthbar, so it's easier to see your HP in later stages 
- **PvP**: Thanks to the new HP changes, PvP is in a better state in the late/end game. It still is not fully balanced, but a PvP focused update will come in the future.

- Highly buffed health and damage of Blackstone Golem to make it fit more within the position it is in the campaign.

- Spin attacks from Spellblades no longer grant Strength/Haste stacks, this is done to make consumables a better choice.

# Prominence II RPG: Hasturian Era
**3.0.7 - Unholy Death Knights**

This update introduces a new class with new weapons, armors and its own skill book; the Unholy Death Knight.
Become a plaguebringer, use abilities that bring diseases to your victims and spread them to multiple targets.

This update also introduces two new armor sets for Frost Death Knights, and two more for Unholy Death Knights!

You might be confused about the balance changes, so please [check the newest blog post for more information](https://rpg.prominence.wiki/blog/3.0.7-changes), it's a bit complex.

## Important Changes
- **Unholy Death Knight**: A versatile melee DPS that can grip targets and infect them with diseases.
- **New Fate Talent: Decaying Devotion**. A Death Knight focused talent that removes elemental powers but increases your Unholy and Blood powers, and grants a passive to increase damage while riding horses.
- **Artifacts can now use Spell enchants**. Artifacts can now use again the spell enchants, making them way more powerful.
- **Balance Changes**. General balance changes to try to get all late game builds to deal consistent ~300 DPS
- **Resistance Changes**. The resistance effect now mitigates 5% of the damage dealt per level.
- **Version Checker**. The version checker from Prominence I is now on Prominence II, notifying you when you're outdated so you can always have your modpack updated!

## Artifact Changes
- Fixed all artifacts (except Thunderwrath) not being able to use Spell enchants such as Spell Infinity or Spell Power.

# Prominence II RPG v3.0.2
**Player Damage Increase**

Due to scaling being harsh in the early game, this update focuses on buffing the player, specially in the early game, to ease out starting the modpack. # Prominence II [RPG] v2.7.0
**Reforging Overhaul**

This update changes completely the reforging mechanics! It is now less random and more progression oriented, it also removes the unique tier and adds another called Mythic, which has similar stats. Along with this, staves and wands are now also reforgable!

There are now 3 tiers of reforging items (that replace the amethyst required before), each allowing you to reforge to certain qualities.

Limestone, found in the overworld, allows you to reforge to Common, Uncommon, Rare and Epic. While Pyrite, found in the Nether, allows to reforge to Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary. Galena, found in the End, allows to Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic.

Most of the qualities of your items will be ported over, but Unique quality items won't be converted into Mythic.

## Changes
- New Reforging Mechanics!
- Added Reforging questline under Combat & Gear
- Amethyst is no longer needed to reforge items
- There are now 3 tiers of reforging materials:
    - Limestone (Found in Overworld)
    - Pyrite (Found in Nether)
    - Galena (Found in End)
- Qualities are now limited to certain materials:
    - To reforge Mythic you will need Galena
    - To reforge Legendary you will need Pyrite (or Galena)
    - To reforge the rest you can use Limestone (or Pyrite/Galena)
- Qualities are now displayed on a plate

Between the additions, the respec tree has been removed completely and replaced with the Knowledge Scroll, a craftable item that resets your talent tree.

# Prominence II [FABRIC] v2.1.0

This is the biggest update that the talent tree has gotten as of now. Adding new nodes, changing its structure, new textures, balance changes and more. And this is just the beginning.

Another thing to note is the new power level system, which shows on top of your inventory. It is meant to display a general number that scales with your gear, stats and talent tree progression. It is an early implementation and it is not perfect, but should work as a general guide to compare your power in a generic way.

This version is also the first one to support cross-compatibility with Modrinth! The modrinth version is not yet public but will come out in the next few days. Stay tuned!

## Changes
- Overhauled talent tree completely. New nodes, changes, and appearances
- Default keybind to open the talent tree is now N instead of K
- Added cross-compatibility with the Modrinth version (not public as of current release)
- Added prominent textures for some modded guis
- Added power level indicator on top of the inventory, higher gear & stats will get you higher power level
- Fixed crash when switching dimensions
- Fixed trinket slots not having textures for trinkets
- Fixed backpack's tool button not being visible 
- Removed variant chests, make sure to swap to vanilla blocks before updating

## Talent Tree Changes
- Start nodes are now path-like which give you unique bonuses
- Added Protector's, Rogue's and Archer's path (For tank, healer, dps melee or dps ranged)
- Added Pyro, enigmatic and frozen knowledge paths (For mages)
- Ice Archmage is now Frost Archmage
- Cat's Grace is now Legolas' Legacy
- Legolas' Legacy now adds handling to draw faster and have better accuracy with bows and crossbows 
- Enhanced the appearance of final nodes
- Changed icons of some nodes
- Added Magic Penetration node
- Added Omnivampirism node
